hardware: Local multi-core CPU (16 threads, PyTorch oneDNN)

raw_yolo11m_batched_16.note: chunk_latency_ms divided by chunk_size, NOT total batch latency
raw_yolo11m_batched_16.percentile_distribution_explanation: 20 images evaluated in two chunks (chunk 1: 16 images @ 1450.9 ms/img, chunk 2: 4 images @ 1203.9 ms/img). Since 80% of samples (16/20) equal 1450.9 ms, both P50 (index 9.5) and P95 (index 18.05) equal 1450.9 ms, while mean is weighted average 1401.5 ms.

foveation_wbf_true_e2e.stage_gap_reconciliation: The 12.0 ms gap between sum of stage means (2898.9 ms) and end-to-end mean (2910.9 ms) represents uninstrumented Python overhead between Stage 1 exit and Stage 2 entry: iterating res_ff.boxes, moving PyTorch tensor coordinates to NumPy arrays, and assembling the ff_dets dictionary list.
foveation_wbf_true_e2e.stage1_vs_standalone_raw_reconciliation: Standalone raw mean (1486.6 ms) was measured with 1 forward pass per frame. In foveation, full-frame inference ran alongside 1.25 crop passes per frame, doubling per-image CPU compute from ~1.5s to ~3.0s, inducing thermal turbo step-down and L3 cache evictions. The 6.5% delta (1583.1 ms vs 1486.6 ms) is expected multitasking CPU variance on Windows.
